title: Code Geass: Lost Stories Game to End Service on December 7
content:
The official website for the Code Geass : Lost Stories social game announced on Wednesday that the game will end service on December 7. Sales of the in-game Sakuradite currency, Lost Stories Pass, and Starter Pack has also ended on Wednesday.

The game launched for smartphones as well as on PC via the DMM Game Player in May 2022. The game is free to play, with optional in-game purchases available. Rock band FLOW performed the game's original theme song "Pendulum."

The game's English version launched for iOS and Android in September 2023 and ended service in August 2024.

The action role-playing game had been originally slated to launch in winter 2018 as a PC browser game, but was then listed with no release window. DMM Games then announced in November 2021 that it was restarting the game's development process with f4samurai as the developers.

Game developer JORO launched the separate Code Geass Knightmare Survivor game for iOS and Android on September 15. The "survivor action" game is free to play, with optional in-game purchases.

The Code Geass franchise is celebrating its 20th anniversary this year and onward with several projects, including a new anime titled Code Geass Hoshi Oi no Aspal ( Code Geass : Aspal the Star Chaser), a new musical stage play , and an exhibition.

title: Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint Returns as Cygames and Breeders’ Cup Renew Partnership
content:
Cygames, Inc. has renewed its partnership with the Breeders’ Cup for the third consecutive year. Under the agreement, the weekend’s sprint race will be named the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint.

The Grade 1 race will take place on Saturday, October 31, at Keeneland Race Course in Lexington, Kentucky, as part of the 43rd Breeders’ Cup World Championships. It offers a $2 million purse and is open to Thoroughbreds aged three and older. The race is run over six furlongs (1,200 meters) on dirt.

The Breeders’ Cup announced that Cygames will have an “expanded on-site presence,” including photos and graphics of Japanese horses. Likewise, a life-sized statue of Forever Young will be displayed at the Keeneland Race Course. Cygames’ logo will be displayed on the starting gate and saddle towels of competing horses.

Heather Higgins, the Breeders’ Cup Senior Vice President of Corporate Partnership, said

“We are very pleased to continue our partnership with Cygames and build upon a relationship that connects two organizations with increasingly global audiences. Japan has become an important part of the Breeders’ Cup story, and Cygames has been a tremendous partner in helping us celebrate that connection in creative and engaging ways. We look forward to bringing their expanded activation to fans at Keeneland this fall.”

The 2026 Breeders’ Cup World Championships include 13 other Grade 1 races, in addition to the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint. Several Umamusume: Pretty Derby characters have placed or won in Breeders’ Cup races.

• Loves Only You — 1st place at the 2021 Breeders’ Cup Filly & Mare Turf, the first Japanese horse to win a Breeders’ Cup Race

• Marche Lorraine — 2nd place at the 2021 Longines Breeders’ Cup Distaff

• Forever Young — 1st place at the 2025 Longines Breeders’ Cup

Susumu Fujita, the chairman and founder of CyberAgent (Cygames’ parent company), owns Forever Young. While Forever Young will return to defend his title, no Umamusume: Pretty Derby horse will compete in the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint. General admission tickets start at $85 .

Cygames owns and created Umamusume: Pretty Derby. The multimedia franchise features anthropomorphic versions of real-world racehorses.

title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime's 1st Video Reveals Cast, More Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kuzushiro 's The Moon on a Rainy Night ( Amayo no Tsuki ) manga began streaming the anime's first full promotional video on Wednesday. The video announces the anime's main cast members, as well as more staff members.

The cast members include:

Iori Saeki as Saki Kindaichi

Sora Amamiya as Kanon Oikawa

The newly announced staff members include Seung Deok Kim and Tsutomu Tomoyuki as assistant directors, Haruko Nobori as the color key artist, Mai Ichioka as the art director, Atsushi Satō as the compositing director of photography, Masahiro Gotō as the editor, Nobuyuki Abe as the sound director, and jizue as the musical composer. CompTown president Masao Yamamura is also credited as animation producer.

Tomoe Makino ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , A Tale of the Secret Saint , Woodpecker Detective's Office ) is directing the anime at CompTown . Shōgo Yasukawa ( Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma , Mitsuboshi Colors , Rock is a Lady's Modesty is writing and overseeing the series scripts, and Ayumi Nishibata ( Otherside Picnic , Migi & Dali ) is designing the characters.

The anime will premiere in 2027.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

One rainy night, Saki is rushing to a piano lesson when she crashes into a beautiful, long-haired girl, dropping her sheet music in the process. Saki stutters an apology, but the girl simply hands back her sheet music and leaves without a word. Saki begins her first day of high school the following morning, only to find the stranger from the night before sitting at the desk next to hers. She learns that the girl's name is Kanon and that she is not quite completely deaf, but very hard of hearing. Though Kanon needs to be close to people to read their lips, she tends to push people away with her icy demeanor. Through one kind gesture, Saki slowly begins breaking down the walls around Kanon, even as she feels something new blossoming within her.

Kuzushiro launched the manga on Kodansha 's Comic Days website in June 2021. Kodansha published the manga's 12th volume in Japan on June 19. Kodansha USA released the eighth volume digitally on December 23.

Kuzushiro also created the Egao no Taenai Shokuba Desu , Chihaya-san wa Sono Mama de Ii (You're Fine the Way You Are, Chihaya-san), Living With My Brother's Wife ( Ani no Yome to Kurashiteimasu. ), Tobaku Senpai Nani Kakeru? , and Akuma no Mama ( Mama Akuma ) manga. Manga UP! publishes Living With My Brother's Wife in English, and Yen Press publishes Mama Akuma in English.

A television anime adaptation of Egao no Taenai Shokuba Desu debuted in October 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired under the title A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace .

Kuzushiro launched her Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san manga in Ichijinsha 's Comic Yuri Hime magazine in 2011, and ended it in January 2017. Ichijinsha published the manga's sixth and final compiled book volume in August 2017. The manga received a 13-episode television anime series adaptation , which premiered in Japan in April 2014. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

title: Babanba Banban Vampire Manga Listed to Enter 'Final Stage'
content:
Dark Horse Comics licensed the manga, and will release the first volume in English on November 10. Dark Horse describes the manga:

An unassuming worker in a long-established public bathhouse is really the lustful 450-year-old vampire Ranmaru Mori! The heir to this esteemed Koi No Yu Bathhouse, Rihito Tatsuno, is a fifteen-year-old virgin—who is about to fall in love for the first time with a girl in his class! Ranmaru begins to weave a desperate plan to prevent Rihito from losing his virginity and to make him fall for Ranmaru instead, so the bloodsucker can eventually have pure, eighteen-year-old virgin blood for his own vampiric self!

Okujima launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine in October 2021. Akita Shoten published the manga's 14th volume on August 6.

The Baban Baban Ban Vampire anime adaptation premiered in Japan on January 11. The anime is streaming on Netflix .

A live-action film of the manga was originally scheduled for a February 2025 release, but was postponed due to "various circumstances." The preview screening scheduled in January 2025 was also canceled. The film opened in July 2025, and ranked at #5 in its opening weekend in Japan.

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Announced
content:
Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4: Founder of the Royal Academy’s So-Called Library Committee is officially getting an anime adaptation. The series’ official website announced the adaptation and confirmed that WIT Studio will continue the animation production.

J-Novel summarizes the first volume of part 4 as follows: Rozemyne has awoken from her two-year slumber. Everything and everyone has changed, which is as terrifying as it sounds, but she doesn’t have time to waste before she’s thrust toward the Royal Academy—a requirement for becoming a noble. There, she will meet all sorts of colorful teachers and students from other duchies… but can she keep her composure in the face of the most books she’s seen yet? Our bookworm goes to school in the newest installment of this biblio-fantasy by book lovers, for book lovers.

The first season of the anime aired in 2019, followed by a second in 2020 and a third in 2022, all animated by Studio Ajia-do. The latest Season aired in spring and summer 2026, with the last episode airing on October 3, 2026, and was animated by Studio WIT.

title: You Are a Four Leaf Clover Romantic Suspense Manga to End in 12th Volume
content:
Retailers are listing the 12th compiled book volume of Koushi 's You Are a Four Leaf Clover ( Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ) manga as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 8.

The romantic suspense manga centers around Uichi, a once popular student who is now relentlessly bullied in high school. Still, he strives everyday to keep a promise to Yotsuha (his first love from elementary school before she transferred schools) to become a veterinarian. Just as he reaches his limit with the bullying, Yotsuha suddenly appears before him. She has seemingly not changed since back then — except she harbors only one hidden resolve deep in her eyes.

Koushi launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in July 2024. Akita Shoten published the manga's 11th compiled book volume on Wednesday.

The manga is inspiring an upcoming anime .
author: ANN

title: 'Amayo no Tsuki' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, First Promo, 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kuzushiro 's Amayo no Tsuki ( The Moon on a Rainy Night ) manga revealed the main cast, additional staff, and the first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Voice actresses Sora Amamiya ( Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku ) and Iori Saeki ( Pon no Michi ) are starring in the anime as Kanon Oikawa and Saki Kindaichi, respectively.

Staff Assistant Director: Tsutomu Tomoyuki ( Kizoku Tensei: Megumareta Umare kara Saikyou no Chikara wo Eru episode director), Seung-deok Kim ( Salaryman ga Isekai ni Ittara Shitennou ni Natta Hanashi ) Color Design: Haruko Nobori ( Koori no Jouheki ) Art Director: Mai Ichioka ( Darwin Jihen ) Director of Photography: Atsushi Satou ( Kirei ni Shitemoraemasu ka. ) Editing: Masahiro Gotou ( Shuumatsu Train Doko e Iku? ) Sound Director: Nobuyuki Abe ( Sasaki to Pii-chan ) Music: jizue ( Hoshiai no Sora ) Animation Producer: Masao Yamamura ( Migi to Dali )

Tomoe Makino ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai ) is helming the anime at CompTown . Shougo Yasukawa ( Rock wa Lady no Tashinami deshite ) is handling the series composition and writing the script. Ayumi Nishihata ( Shirobako ) is designing the characters.

Kuzushiro began serializing the girls' love drama web manga on the Comic Days website in June 2021. Kodansha released the 12th volume on June 19.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in November 2022 and released the eighth volume in December 2025. The ninth volume is scheduled to go on sale on December 8.

title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Reveals First Trailer, Main Cast
content:
The previously announced The Moon on a Rainy Night anime revealed its first trailer along with the main cast on Wednesday. The anime is slated to premiere in 2027 and the main voice cast consists of:

• Sora Amamiya as Kanon Oikawa

• Iori Saeki as Saki Kindaichi

The Moon on a Rainy Night anime staff includes:

• Original Work: Kuzushiro (Serialized on Comic Days published by Kodansha)

• Director: Tomoe Makino

• Series Composition and Script: Shogo Yasukawa

• Character Design: Ayumi Nishibata

• Music: jizue

• Animation Production: CompTown

Synopsis: The Moon on a Rainy Night “It’s a metaphor for the things you can’t see. Like the moon, hidden behind the rain clouds.” Just before starting high school, Saki Kindaichi encounters a striking girl with long, flowing hair—Kanon Oikawa—on her way to a piano lesson. To her surprise, they meet again at the entrance ceremony, now as classmates. Kanon is hard of hearing and tends to keep her distance from others. Saki, unsettled by how some classmates and teachers treat Kanon, feels compelled to reach out. Moved by Saki’s quiet determination, Kanon begins to let down her guard… and little by little, her world starts to change. A gentle, everyday rhythm brings their hearts closer, one step at a time. This is a story of two girls—of unseen struggles, unspoken bonds, and a love that quietly takes root. title: Live-Action Can You Kiss Me First? Series' Teaser Reveals Theme Song
content:
The official website for the live-action series of Yamayade 's Can You Kiss Me First? ( Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo ) boys' love manga presented a new teaser trailer for the series on Wednesday. The teaser announces and previews the series' theme song "Shiranai" (I Don't Know) by Urashimasakatasen .

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and will begin releasing it on September 29. Seven Seas Entertainment describes the story:

Ueno and Kanada seem like two complete opposites in the office. Ueno is an accountant who can strike fear into his co-workers with his strict and unbending ways. Meanwhile, Kanda is the superstar of the sales department—and thanks to his friendly and outgoing personality, he is even next in line to be manager! While most would think these two could never mesh, the truth is they're actually very close friends outside of work.

Kanda often crashes at Ueno's place, and the two spend time with each other constantly, growing closer than most co-workers would. But when Ueno confesses to Kanada that he's gay, a myriad of unsaid feelings begin to grow between them. Ueno has mixed feelings about how close and touchy Kanada can be, while Kanada is hung up on the fact that Ueno claimed he wasn't his type!

Can these two salarymen navigate their true feelings and realize the growing love between them?

The series will star Jin Suzuki (live-action Kimi ni Todoke , Teasing Master Takagi-san , left in visual on right) as Ueno, and Gaku Oshida (live-action Grapara! , Samurai Sensei, right) as Kanda.

Other cast members include ( Note: Character name romanizations not official ):

• Yoshiki Kanemaru as Tōma Fujisawa

• Tsubasa Kizu as Yūsuke Kobayashi

• Riko Kawase as Akira Mizoguchi

• Kōya Matsuda as Kōtarō Shirai

• Jun Yamasaki as Satoshi Kanda

• Kakeru Amemiya as Takumi

• Sōshō Tomimoto as Yūto Shima

• Aika Sonoda as Yuika Nakagawa

Meigetsu Takahashi is directing the series, with scripts by Emi Amamoto. Nobuhiro Tateno and Ami Yamashita are composing the music.

The series will premiere on Fuji TV on October 19, and will also stream on Fuji TV On Demand .

The manga was serialized on Renta! from March 2023 to April 2024. Takeshobo published one compiled book volume for the manga.

Aika Sonoda as Yuika Nakagawa
Meigetsu Takahashi is directing the series, with scripts by Emi Amamoto. Nobuhiro Tateno and Ami Yamashita are composing the music.
The series will premiere on Fuji TV on October 19, and will also stream on Fuji TV On Demand .
The manga was serialized on Renta! from March 2023 to April 2024. Takeshobo published one compiled book volume for the manga.

title: 5 More Critically Acclaimed Anime Crunchyroll Removed & You Can’t Stream Anywhere Else
content:
There’s no de

Crunchyroll is the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the world, home to over a thousand series and movies. Each year, the platform adds a few dozen new releases to make them more accessible for fans. This also means that a large number of series and films can be found on Crunchyroll, including older classics and the latest hits. However, it’s not rare for the platform to quietly remove some beloved shows without any announcement. These removals mostly happen due to licensing issues. Even though certain anime are exclusive to the platform, Crunchyroll only buys rights to stream them for a certain period of time.

Over time, the license expires, forcing the platform to remove such anime from its library. Additionally, while it’s possible for Crunchyroll to renew those licenses, it depends on the popularity of the anime. Regardless of critical acclaim, if an anime doesn’t have a good enough viewership, the platform would prefer to let them go. It hasn’t been long since these incredible anime were removed from Crunchyroll, and now fans in the U.S. can’t stream them anywhere.

5) Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers

This is a rather underrated entry on the list, but the story is rather unique for an action fantasy. The anime never released a second season, and it might not return after the sudden removal from the platform. The story focuses on an ancient legend, with the revival of the Demon God, six heroes dubbed the Braves of the Six Flowers. These heroes will be chosen by the Goddess of Fate, granting them power to rise up against the fiends attempting to turn the world into a living hell.

Adlet Mayer, self-proclaimed Strongest Man in the World, becomes one of the chosen ones. The story continues as he embarks on a destined journey to fight the Demon God and meets up with the fellow heroes. However, things take a drastic turn when seven heroes are present instead of six, leading everyone to believe Adlet is a fraud. Now he must do everything he can to find the true imposter and fulfill his destiny of defeating the Demon God.

4) Grimgar, Ashes and Illusions

This underrated isekai is yet another series that never released a second season. It centers around a group of strangers who wake up in a mysterious fantasy world with no memories of their past lives. Unlike most isekai shows where the reincarnated or transmigrated characters adapt to their surroundings quickly, this anime doesn’t shy away from showing the brutal reality of being powerless and unprepared.

It’s a matter of survival for them as they’re only ordinary people thrust into a dangerous world where they must fight monsters for food and money. Their struggles are visceral and slow-paced, emphasizing the weight of every decision while they try to come out of this conundrum alive. The lack of overpowered characters and the fear of death makes the story deeply human, as the group relies on teamwork, trial and error, and bonds to survive.

3) Darker Than Black

Much like Noragami , Darker Than Black was forged thanks to Studio Bones, though this tale is far different from its predecessor earlier on the list. Focusing on covert agents known as “Contractors,” the anime adaptation got its start in 2007 with a full season of twenty-five episodes. It would then receive a sequel series in 2009, thanks to Darker Than Black: Gemini of Meteor , further expanding on its world. With the series also receiving a spin-off anime in 2010 of four episodes in Darker Than Black: Gaiden , the franchise is deserving of returning to the airwaves thanks to its unique storytelling style.

2) Orange

Even after more than a decade since its premiere, this time travel drama gets praise for its exceptional story and unique themes. While not a mainstream hit, the anime always had a dedicated fanbase, even if it’s been reduced over the past few years. The story centers around Naho Takamiya, whose first day of her sophomore year of high school takes a strange turn. She wakes up late and finds a mysterious letter addressed to her. However, she never expected that the letter was from herself 10 years in the future.

Although she is initially skeptical of the note, after witnessing several events described to take place, she realizes the letter really is from her 26-year-old self. The letter details Naho’s future full of regrets and hopes her younger self can correct the mistakes that were made in the past. With the knowledge of the future in her hands, she carefully makes decisions on what to do next in her life.

1) Akame Ga Kill

Since the manga ended two years after the anime, fans got a much better and happier conclusion than the anime. The animation studio completely ignored everything the manga did right and opted for a tragic conclusion with the death of the protagonist. However, he survives in the manga, even though he was transformed into a dragon-like creature due to overusing his Incursio armor. It’s not only Tatsumi, but even Mine survives and marries him.

Not only that, but even when a character’s fate didn’t deviate from the manga, the anime changed the events leading up to it, ruining its impact. The ending seems even more meaningless when none of the major characters actually live to see the rebellion’s victory, even if they fought so hard for it.
